name: Kings Kamp RV Resort & Marina
note: Mostly seasonal: 2025-26 reviewers say most sites are held by snowbirds who come back every year, and the transient sites are tight. Reservations by phone or email only, with no online booking. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site kingskamp.com read 2026-10-30: daily and weekly rates for RV lots 1-60 with full hookups, phone 305-451-0010, joint site map (KK-CJ-Map PDF) and 2026 overnight rules; RV Life reviews of nightly stays Jan-Mar 2026 ($85-$135 a night, one a 1-night stop, motorhomes and trailers); Campendium lists 60 sites to 40 ft (30-ft Class C 2021, 41-ft fifth wheel 2021); Good Sam directory types it CAMPGROUND (not a condo park); no minimum, application or lease anywhere; Google Maps open with phone, 3.8/225 -> real transient RV park; price gate lifted: Florida Keys zone (AWH 2026-10-30, gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-30: the operator's site map (kingskamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/KK-CJ-Map-FINAL-8.5x11.pdf) puts Kings Kamp lots 38-41 along the marina dock and lots 51-54 at the marina by the boat ramp, with 'Florida Bay Waterfront' labelled on the shore. Esri Wayback Monroe County Orthos 2024-01 (release 49999, z20 at 25.13975,-80.40300, rendered, read) shows RVs parked nose-in on the seawall of the marina channel, a few metres from the water with only the dock walkway between and boats tied alongside. The channel opens straight into Florida Bay about 40 m NW, with the bay visible across it, so this is open salt water with no road, lot or treeline between pad and water. An RV Life reviewer (3/2026) had site 51 'on the water (up against the marina slip)'. The rest of the park (lots 1-37, 42-50, 55-60) sits inland under canopy, so only those rows are on the water. Precedent: canal-side pads with boats tied = on-water (Lakeport 14424).
fees_source: https://kingskamp.com/ RV Site Rates table, read 2026-10-30: daily rate per lot group, before sales tax, double occupancy, water and electricity included for stays under 90 days in winter or 30 in summer. Winter Nov 1 2027-Apr 30 2028 (in season): lots 1-37 $115, 42-50 $120, 55-60 $135, 38-41 and 51-54 $140. Summer May 1-Oct 31 2027: lots 1-37 $100 up to $125 (lots 38-41 weekly only). Holidays and events add $15 a night. No resort or grounds fee for registered guests; visitors pay $10 a day. There is no booking engine (bookings by phone or email), so no engine quote was run. RV Life campers reported paying $85-$135 a night in Jan-Mar 2026.
flags: Cheapest in-season (winter) night is $115 before tax (lots 1-37); summer from $100.
The posted table covers summer 2027 and winter Nov 2027-Apr 2028; no rate for winter 2026-27 is posted. 2026 reviewers paid $85-$135.

Google 3.8/225 is middling, not very poor. The RV Life and Campendium reviews I read (2021-2026, ratings 4-10 of 10) complain of narrow, tight, crowded sites and uneven pads, and a 2026 fifth-wheel couple barely fit; none complains of the staff or cleanliness. I did not read the Google review text. I would add.

Mostly seasonal (reviews: 'mostly seasonal campers' 3/2026; returning snowbirds 2025; full-timers with built-up extensions 2021), but no site count or seasonal share is published anywhere, so long-stay test 4 passes on no count. Every lot group has a posted daily rate and a 2026 reviewer stayed one night.
No online booking: Book Now is a mailto link; reservations by phone 305-451-0010 or reservationskl@kingskamp.com, accepted 18 months ahead; deposits non-refundable inside 61 days.

Shares its grounds map and rules with Captain Jax next door (a separate candidate, slug captain-jax-rv-resort-and-marina; MHVillage lists it as a 24-site mobile home park at the same 103620 address). Kings Kamp's own rate table covers lots 1-60, which I pinned in the southern loop. Check the two results don't describe the same sites.
Pets need approval, with a long banned-breed list (Campendium 2024: no dogs over 40 lb). A 2021 reviewer was refused for a skoolie's condition.
